title: Dad cried
simplified_paragraphs: 爸爸的工作很忙。每天我还没起床，他就走了；晚上我要睡觉了，他才回家。昨天我生日，我就打电话问爸爸他一个小时可以赚多少钱，他有点儿不高兴。我说：“爸爸，我现在有二十块钱，想买你一个小时，可以吗？今天我想和你一起吃生日蛋糕。”然后爸爸在电话里哭了。
traditional_paragraphs: 爸爸的工作很忙。每天我還沒起床，他就走了；晚上我要睡覺了，他才回家。昨天我生日，我就打電話問爸爸他一個小時可以賺多少錢，他有點兒不高興。我說：“爸爸，我現在有二十塊錢，想買你一個小時，可以嗎？今天我想和你一起吃生日蛋糕。”然後爸爸在電話裡哭了。
pinyin_paragraphs: bà ba de gōng zuò hěn máng。 měi tiān wǒ hái méi qǐ chuáng， tā jiù zǒu le； wǎn shang wǒ yào shuì jiào le， tā cái huí jiā。 zuó tiān wǒ shēng rì， wǒ jiù dǎ diàn huà wèn bà ba tā yī gè xiǎo shí kě yǐ zhuàn duō shao qián， tā yǒu diǎn r bù gāo xìng。 wǒ shuō：“ bà ba， wǒ xiàn zài yǒu èr shí kuài qián， xiǎng mǎi nǐ yī gè xiǎo shí， kě yǐ ma？ jīn tiān wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ yī qǐ chī shēng rì dàn gāo。” rán hòu bà ba zài diàn huà lǐ kū le。
english_paragraphs: Dad's work is very busy. Every day before I get up, he leaves; at night, when I go to bed, he comes home. Yesterday, my birthday, I called my dad and asked him how much he could earn in an hour. He was a little unhappy. I said, "Dad, I have twenty yuan now, and I want to buy you an hour, can you? I want to eat birthday cake with you today." Then Dad cried on the phone.
english_full: Dad's work is very busy. Every day before I get up, he leaves; at night, when I go to bed, he comes home. Yesterday, my birthday, I called my dad and asked him how much he could earn in an hour. He was a little unhappy. I said, "Dad, I have twenty yuan now, and I want to buy you an hour, can you? I want to eat birthday cake with you today." Then Dad cried on the phone.
